notes:
Oats everywhere: the app identity changed from the old codename, your notes and settings migrate automatically, and macOS asks for permissions once more.
The floating lozenge now adapts to light and dark backgrounds natively, collapses without the squared-off flash, and centers its record button.
Join & Record: calendar events with a Zoom, Meet, Teams, or Webex link open the call and start the note in one click.
Settings gains a clearly marked reset that erases all data on this Mac.
Onboarding no longer blocks on permissions.
